description: A dialog over the main window to add another machine's Baude host process to the mesh, by where ssh goes. The host is kept from then on, reached or not.

parts.name: destination field
parts.shows: A text entry about 30 characters wide, focused, with the placeholder "user@host, or an ssh alias". Takes an alias in ~/.ssh/config, a host name or address, or user@host; it must not start with "-".

actions.does: Add is enabled only while the text can be given to ssh as where to go. Enter confirms.

parts.name: command field
parts.shows: A second text entry with placeholder "baude_headless.py, on its PATH": the host process's command there, run as `<command> connect`. Empty if baude_headless.py is on its PATH, else its path (in a checkout of Baude, <checkout>/baude_headless.py; not the baude launcher, which runs the app).

parts.name: Add
parts.shows: "Add" button, the default, suggested style, disabled until the destination is valid.

actions.does: The host is added (by ssh with the destination and the command) and a toast says "Looking for Baude on <destination>"; it then appears in the host picker.

removed.name: This phone's key (and New Key…) in Add Host
removed.why: The phone's key lives on This phone, under Key Material; Add Host is just the endpoint
